swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: TPS63001DRCR uses VSON-10 (10-pin, DRC) while TPS63020DSJR uses VSON-14 (14-pin, DSJ); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (VOUT vs VIN), Pin 2 (SW vs GND), Pin 3 (GND vs FB), Pin 4 (SW vs VOUT), Pin 5 (VIN vs VOUT), Pin 6 (EN vs SW), Pin 7 (PS vs SW), Pin 8 (VIN vs SW), Pin 9 (GND vs SW), Pin 10 (FB vs VIN), Pin 11 (NONE vs VIN), Pin 12 (NONE vs EN), Pin 13 (NONE vs PS), Pin 14 (NONE vs PG). Soldering TPS63020DSJR onto a TPS63001DRCR footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.

HIGH SWITCHING FREQUENCY SHIFT: fsw differs by 38% (TPS63001DRCR: 1500 kHz p.5 vs TPS63020DSJR: 2400 kHz p.6); re-evaluate inductor core loss, ripple current ΔIL, output capacitor ESR ripple, and EMI harmonics.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (TPS63001DRCR: 2.2 µH p.1 vs TPS63020DSJR: 1.5 µH p.13); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.
HIGH FEEDBACK CONFIGURATION: One converter is fixed-output while the other is adjustable; external R1/R2 feedback resistors and feedforward capacitor must be updated.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: TPS63001DRCR specifies 1200 mA (continuous Iout, p.1) vs TPS63020DSJR 3000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1). Remember boost Iout,max is strictly less than Isw due to duty-cycle scaling.
engineering_verdict: TPS63001DRCR (Texas Instruments, VSON-10) and TPS63020DSJR (Texas Instruments, VSON-14) are NOT pin-to-pin drop-in compatible (Level 3 PCB Layout Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (VOUT vs VIN), Pin 2 (SW vs GND), Pin 3 (GND vs FB), Pin 4 (SW vs VOUT), Pin 5 (VIN vs VOUT), Pin 6 (EN vs SW), Pin 7 (PS vs SW), Pin 8 (VIN vs SW), Pin 9 (GND vs SW), Pin 10 (FB vs VIN), Pin 11 (NONE vs VIN), Pin 12 (NONE vs EN), Pin 13 (NONE vs PS), Pin 14 (NONE vs PG). Key datasheet deltas: topology is buck-boost (sync) vs buck-boost (sync), switching frequency is 1500 kHz (p.5) vs 2400 kHz (p.6), rated current is 1200 mA (p.1) vs 3000 mA (p.1), typical inductor is 2.2 µH (p.1) vs 1.5 µH (p.13), and Iq is 41 µA (p.5) vs 25 µA (p.6). Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.4), thermal margin (θJA 46.8 vs 41.8 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
